title: AnimationMixer: Fix track cache hash collisions
body:
### Summary
Fixes AnimationMixer track cache collisions where different animation tracks with the same hash can alias to the same cache entry and animate the wrong target.

### Problem
When two track paths collide on hash, AnimationMixer may reuse the wrong TrackCache.
This can cause incorrect blending/application (e.g. one track influencing another property/node), as reported in the issue repro.

### Root cause
Track cache lookup and reuse relied on hash identity too heavily, so hash collisions were not fully disambiguated at cache resolution/use sites.

### Solution
Updated [animation_mixer.cpp](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/guanxin/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/b6a47e94e3/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) and [animation_mixer.h](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/guanxin/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/b6a47e94e3/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) to:

resolve track cache entries by [(thash + path + cache type)](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/guanxin/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/b6a47e94e3/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) instead of hash alone, while keeping hash as the primary index;
use collision probing to find/store a unique cache key when hashes conflict;
make per-track weight deduplication key off [TrackCache *](vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/guanxin/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/b6a47e94e3/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html) identity rather than hash value;
keep the existing cache architecture with minimal, targeted changes.

### Testing
Built editor locally on Windows with incremental SCons build.
Validated the collision scenario from the issue (colliding track paths) and confirmed tracks are resolved independently without cross-influence.
Checked normal animation playback behavior to ensure no obvious regressions.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/99c6052d-d88f-441c-9886-d6febf5fc5c1


### Notes
Minimal, targeted fix for hash-collision handling in AnimationMixer cache lookup/reuse.
No scripting API changes.

Fixes #116231
